 11-Day Vote Centers for the November 3 Election Open on October 24 
 11-Day Vote Centers for the November 3 Election Open on October 24
 The 11-Day Vote Center at Magnolia Park United Methodist Church will open tomorrow, October 24. 
 4-Day Vote Centers will be open at the following locations beginning October 31 :  
 Buena Vista Branch Library 300 N. Buena Vista St. 
 Burbank Town Center Mall (third floor in the Sears wing) 201 E. Magnolia Blvd 
 Courtyard by Marriott (in the Empire Center) 2100 Empire Ave 
 Vote Centers are open from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. from October 24–November 2 and from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. on Election Day, November 3, 2026. 
 There are four 24-Hour Vote-by-Mail Drop Boxes in Burbank at the following locations:  
 Burbank City Hall 275 E. Olive Ave. 
 Buena Vista Library 300 N. Buena Vista St. 
 George Izay Park/Joslyn Adult Center 1301 W. Olive Ave 
 Ralph Foy Park/Northwest Library 3211 W. Victory Blvd 
 For a full list of Vote Centers and Vote-by-Mail Drop Boxes, visit lavote.gov or call (800) 815-2666. You can also contact the Burbank City Clerk’s Office at (818) 238-5851 or email [email protected] for more information.
